{{Top|leg}}
"'''Unset'''" was a term given to [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] that were believed to be unfit for [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlement. The term was coined during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and remained in use by survey and exploration teams serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] was originally marked as "Unset" upon its discovery by the Republic.
